mutants.description: Treating a percentage as millimeters breaks the public 50% versus 0.2 mm equivalence on a 0.4 mm wall.
Reversing expansion contracts the 2 mm ledges at the +0.2 mm case, shrinking the eligible 1.6 mm support strip instead of growing its footprint and emitted path with normal(auto) snug support.
